notes: Real files from ANVISA's open-data server, https://dados.anvisa.gov.br/dados/CONSULTAS/PRODUTOS/ (no auth). The CSVs are too big to keep, so headers_*.txt holds the response headers and *_head.csv the header row plus a handful of records copied byte for byte (never re-encode them; .gitattributes marks them -text). Records were chosen to cover the format's edge cases: Windows-1252 bytes 0x92/0x96/0x99, quotes inside quoted fields that ANVISA does not escape, line breaks inside fields, HTML entities in MARCAS and NO_PRODUTO, DT_VENCIMENTO_REGISTRO as MMYYYY and MM/YYYY, ST_PRODUTO_ATIVO = X, CNPJs with leading zeros, and resultado rows that join main rows on CO_SEQ_APRESENTACAO_PRODUTO.
